brief:
Israel is continuing military operations in Lebanon despite pressure from President Donald Trump to halt the conflict, Al-Monitor reported. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Foreign Minister Israel Katz are prioritizing gains in Lebanon over Trump's push for a ceasefire, as both leaders face elections this fall. Netanyahu's government views progress in the border conflict as crucial to its electoral prospects.

Trump, preparing for his own election campaign, has pushed for stability in Lebanon, but Israel's leadership sees continued military operations as essential for domestic political reasons. The divergence between the two allies reflects competing electoral timelines and strategic priorities in the coming months.
dek: Both Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump face fateful elections this fall, but one needs progress in Lebanon while the other wants more of the same.
title: Netanyahu defies Trump pressure, prioritizes Lebanon military operations
